questions.question: Operand %0 refers to?
options: First listed operand (outputs first, then inputs)
questions.explanation: Numbering follows declaration order across outputs then inputs.

questions.question: "+r"(x) means?
options: Read-write, any register, seeded with x and written back

questions.question: volatile on rdtsc because?
options: Timing reads must execute exactly placed; optimizer must not merge/hoist
questions.explanation: Without it, two reads collapse and deltas lie.

questions.question: "cc" clobber confesses?
options: Flags register changed by the instruction
questions.explanation: add sets flags; nearby branches depend on the truth.

questions.question: cpuid vendor order b,d,c because?
options: Intel spreads EBX,EDX,ECX in that order for leaf 0
questions.explanation: Hardware contract, memorized once in the helper.

questions.question: Inline ASM mostly buys?
options: Access to instructions C cannot spell (cpuid/rdtsc/in/out)
questions.explanation: Same codegen for add; irreplaceable for special instructions.
